notes: Appearance Shield now detects user-initiated BCOM outfit edits without a manual 90-second allowance. Requires a genuine browser gesture and identifiable BCOM call path. Retains R133 plushie rendering fix and all v3.5.74 Harmonizer improvements.

items: Allows a short 8-second, renewable operation window for asynchronous BCOM outfit application, so repeated manual 90-second allowances are usually unnecessary.
Disallows changes that are not attributable to user-initiated BCOM activity; generic clicks and BCOM installation alone do not grant trust.
Turning off BCOM auto-allow cancels any outstanding BCOM-specific allowance immediately.
Retains Allow BCOM Outfit Edits for 90 Seconds as fallback for BCOM versions with unrecognizable stack traces.
No additional recurring timer. Event listeners activate only when Appearance Shield is enabled.
Settings remain scoped to the current Bondage Club member number.
Based on v3.5.74; R133 remote plushie rendering, Harmonizer material categories/layer rules, Outfit Lock, achievements, crafting, wardrobe, and mobile navigation preserved.
Never bypasses BC server authority, item locks, restraints, or native game permissions.
BCOM user-intent detection is best-effort, not cryptographic addon authentication. Unidentifiable asynchronous actions may still need the manual allowance.
Does not fix the separately reported BCOM missing-outfits/interface problem, which requires a separate diagnosis.
Ten JavaScript regression suites passed; real R133 and BCOM testing is still required.
